audience: lawyers and law firm staff who manage matters, time and bills in Clio

useCases.title: List open matters with the responsible attorney
useCases.text: Searches matters by number, description or client name and shows client, practice area, responsible attorney and status. One matter can be opened in full.

useCases.title: Check unbilled time and overdue bills
useCases.text: Lists time and expense entries with hours, rate and billing status for a matter or user, and bills by state, overdue flag or date, with the amount due.

useCases.title: Find tasks, or create and update them
useCases.text: Lists tasks by matter, assignee, status, priority or due date, creates a task for a user or contact, and marks one complete or changes its due date.

useCases.title: Record time on a matter
useCases.text: Records billable or non-billable time on a matter. You give the hours as a decimal and an optional hourly price.

useCases.title: Add matter or contact notes, or log calls and emails
useCases.text: Adds a note to a matter or contact, or records a phone call or email in the communication log, optionally on a matter.

useCases.title: Open a new matter for a client
useCases.text: Finds the client contact or creates one, then opens a new matter with a description for that client.
